statement: Warren 2026-10-16: the sell-through upload = pick a reporting customer, not a 'source'. (1) The upload picker lists ONLY customers ticked as reporting customers (the same list that drives the late/missing report slots); there is no user-facing 'source' choice. (2) Every sell-through upload loads into the one sell-through table with its standard columns. (3) The only per-customer configuration is the column layout: the first upload of an unrecognised layout opens the existing column-mapping step to map headers to the standard sell-through columns, and the layout is saved for that customer; later uploads match a saved layout by headers automatically; a customer may have several saved layouts (e.g. weekly report, history file, wide-week). (4) Test/build-session sources never appear to users.
